about_the_game:
This pack allows you to change the background music in battles in "Versus Mode" to the anime songs and soundtracks from the anime "Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba."

What's included:

• Anime Songs

Gurenge -TV Version-／LiSA

Homura -Short Version-／LiSA

Akeboshi -TV version-／LiSA

Zankyosanka -TV version-／Aimer

Kizuna no Kiseki -TV version-／MAN WITH A MISSION × milet

MUGEN -TV version-／MY FIRST STORY × HYDE

• Soundtracks

Demon Slayer Corps -OST ver.-／Go Shiina

Water Breathing／Go Shiina

Consecutive Attacks ~ Clear Blue Sky ~ Toppling the Train Over／Go Shiina

Rengoku's Fierce Battle／Go Shiina

The Mission Begins: Infiltrate the Entertainment District／Go Shiina

The Battle Versus Daki and Gyutaro Concludes／Go Shiina

The Swordsmith Village Arc Begins／Go Shiina

I'm Going to Protect You All, Okay?／Yuki Kajiura

※To use this content, purchase of the full game "Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles 2" is required. Additionally, the latest patch must be applied.

※Songs can only be used in battles in "Versus Mode."

※Songs included in this pack cannot be used for gameplay video distribution. If the Music Player Settings is changed to "Restricted," the default stage background music will play instead.

※Songs are versions shortened for the game.

※Content and specifications are subject to change without notice.

content_descriptors.notes: There are blood effects and decapitation when fighting demons.
